description: Oregon: Metro RLIS Taxlots (Public) for Clackamas, Multnomah and Washington Counties, for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/sources/or-metro-rlis-taxlots.md.

sources.publisher: Metro (Oregon), Data Resource Center, Regional Land Information System (RLIS)
sources.gate: Terms: the RLIS Open Database End User License Agreement (revised February 2023) prohibits sublicensing, does not license the individual contents of the database and is revocable, and the FGDC metadata asserts Clackamas County copyright. The record holds no written statement from Metro on whether, and in what form, FactLot may carry the derived parcel facts; until one is recorded (Metro Data Resource Center, drc@oregonmetro.gov), nothing from this source is published or hosted.
sources.license: RLIS Open Database End User License Agreement (Metro, revised February 2023), the agreement the item's licenseInfo and the layer's FGDC use-constraints name; text read 2026-11-06 from public Hub page item 43a73dbe46e644a9a8204afc4cbeb525. It is not the Open Database License (ODbL), which the 2026-11-03 record had inferred from search results. Metro grants 'a limited, worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive, revocable license' to copy, publish, distribute and adapt the Data under the agreement's own terms; 'Sublicensing the Data is prohibited'; the licence does not cover 'Rights to individual contents contained in the database' or third-party rights Metro is not authorized to license. The FGDC metadata says the product 'contains information retrieved from and copyrighted by County of Clackamas'. Ownership information is excluded from the open data by Metro ('excluding ownership information') and sold separately
sources.ai_use: Not addressed by the agreement. robots.txt on gis.oregonmetro.gov (Metro's metadata host) sets 'Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference' for all user agents
sources.redistribution: Not cleared for FactLot. The agreement allows copying, publishing and distributing the Data only under its own terms and with Metro's attribution statement; each recipient receives Metro's licence directly, sublicensing is prohibited, and the licence is revocable. The registry configuration cannot express a narrower permission (for example hosted lookups without a downloadable file), so neither a downloadable release nor hosted lookups of these facts are offered while the terms gate is open. Attribution: Regional Land Information System data are a product of Metro and made publicly available according to the license agreement found in https://rlisdiscovery.oregonmetro.gov/pages/open-database-license
sources.notes: Rights review 2026-11-06: the licence is Metro's RLIS Open Database End User License Agreement, not ODbL, and the source is not verified until the terms gate is resolved. Load of 2026-11-06 from the live layer (publisher's content date 2026-11-02; the Hub CSV export was stale, Last-Modified 2026-02-19): 34,210 commercial parcels (Clackamas 6,090; Multnomah 20,684; Washington 7,436), no owner facts; see the review record. Earlier notes (2026-11-03): Statewide? No: tri-county (Clackamas, Multnomah, Washington), 647,192 tax lots in the live layer, updated 2026-07-17 (layer 3 of FeatureServer Taxlots_(Public) on services2.arcgis.com/McQ0OlIABe29rJJy). The Hub export (rlisdiscovery -> 302 -> hub.arcgis.com/api/v3/datasets/b3cabe58..._3/downloads/data?format=csv&spatialRefId=2913&where=1%3D1) answers 200 text/csv, chunked, without Content-Length, and rejects Range requests; its Last-Modified was 2026-02-19 on 2026-11-03, i.e. an export cached before the layer's July update, so check Last-Modified before relying on it. The review took the first 30 MB of the stream (118,956 tax lots) and queried the live layer for totals. The CSV header is the field names. Multnomah County sells owner and detail files on a fee schedule (see the review record). robots.txt: rlisdiscovery.oregonmetro.gov and hub.arcgis.com both Crawl-delay 60, disallow /sites/ /admin/ /sessions/ /groups/ /people/ /workspace/ (not the download API); services2.arcgis.com none. Full export is over 50 MB, so no snapshot was taken here.
